method: Actual unchanged native GLB skinning at 32 loop samples, independently normalized and weapon-IK tested for shotgun and nailgun. Texture decode is skipped only for CPU numeric analysis.
units: 44-world-unit normalized character; Three X=game x, Y=game height z, Z=game ground y

models.directionInvariantMinY: A rotation about native Y changes X/Z only, so exact minY is shared by all 16 native directions.

rootMotion.method: remove net linear XZ travel only; preserve closed-cycle sway and vertical motion

limitations: This is numeric source-geometry analysis, not a completed 32-frame GPU bake or browser visual approval.
Sole height is exact skinned body minimum Y, not a bone origin or raster alpha bottom; textures and frames are never re-encoded.
Original loop timestamps are duration*i/32 with no duplicate endpoint. Original interpolation is evaluated by AnimationSampler.
The weapon-ready IK is applied using each actual existing weapon support vector; no new weapon geometry or guessed attachment is substituted.
Full per-frame run sole correction would remove the real running flight; head/hip ranges explicitly show the resulting change.
No game source, physics, RNG, save, manifest, source metadata, atlas PNG, GLB, browser or user state was changed.
